mentions.title: vg30 premature bearing failure help
mentions.snippet: A Nissan VG30DETT builder reports King XP M4104STDX cap-side main bearings 2 and 3 failed on teardown, with 1 and 4 showing wear; single report, cause (install, oiling, other) not established in the snippet.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread: one user says King main thrust bearings made since 2024 may be problematic, and a tech told him his 2024 main was out of spec on free spread; the same user concedes it may not matter in practice.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully: still no King or official brand reply, thread open and not locked, and the newest post is unchanged at 3 June 2026 where the OP reports his replacement NOS Clevite thrust bearings measured in spec.

mentions.title: Just call it what it is: King bearings are no longer an option
mentions.snippet: Availability complaint, not a quality one: a vendor says King 6-bolt DSM bearings are effectively discontinued; another poster pushes back that King just has irregular production runs.
mentions.replyNote: Returned HTTP 403 Forbidden with no response body again, same as every prior check; thread content still never read.
